name: HARV-03 sale stock and no-harvest state survive server restart

tests.name: Resolve the accepted planet from durable state

data.sql: SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='HARV03 exchange acceptance';

tests.name: Reconnected owner cannot harvest previously sold units
Restart preserves sale record, empty planet stock and paid owner credits

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(quantity)=10 FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet}) AND (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{harv03_planet} AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa')) AND (SELECT credits=5000+(SELECT SUM(credits_paid) FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet}) FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
